title: hotfix: slo-enforcer timeout fallback and regional failover stability
author: Marcus Chen
description:
Context: Customers on Dedicated observed a higher-than-expected error rate when the SLO enforcer hit downstream timeouts during regional maintenance windows. Root cause analysis showed a combination of (1) aggressive per-request timeout propagation from the enforcer to the circuit-breaker subsystem and (2) a missing fallback path in the regional failover path which caused requests to be dropped instead of re-routing. This led to violation of transient latency SLOs and triggered large-scale load-shedding.

This PR implements a conservative timeout fallback and smoother hysteresis for the SLO enforcer to reduce thrashing during transient regional latency spikes. Changes include:
- Add a local timeout clamp in the SLO enforcer: when downstream latency crosses the warning threshold, instead of immediately propagating the tighter timeout to child calls, we apply a bounded clamp with a minimum grace window (configurable).
- Introduce exponential smoothing to the enforcer's error-rate estimates used for circuit-breaker tripping (reduces sensitivity to short spikes).
- Ensure regional failover path has an explicit fallback route that will attempt best-effort re-routing to the next available region instead of immediate hard-dropping when CB capacity is low.
- Add unit + integration tests for timeout clamp behavior, smoothing, and regional failover logic.

Backwards compatibility: default behavior preserved; the new clamp and smoothing parameters are feature-gated behind runtime flags and default to conservative values that only relax aggressive propagation. No public API changes. See release_notes for customer-facing summary.

Testing & rollout: Unit tests + integration tests run in CI. Staged rollout to Dedicated (canary on two customers) with feature flags, monitor SLOs, and rollback plan if error rate increases. Linear tickets: ENG-5821 (hotfix), ENG-5823 (follow-up metrics/observability).

Checklist:
- [x] Unit tests added
- [x] Integration test for regional re-route added
- [x] Feature flag gating
- [x] Load testing reproducer executed against canary
- [x] Docs updated (internal runbook)
